szoveg_eredeti:
Nearly 1 in 3 of more than 350 products Amazon advertised as deals during recent Black Friday and Cyber Monday sales provided no savings at all.

We reviewed the prices of hundreds of Amazon “deals” across Black Friday and Cyber Monday to answer a simple question: do “deals” during Amazon’s holiday sale events offer customers lower prices for products than what they could’ve paid in the preceding weeks? Many times, we found that the answer was no.
